results.bound: NP-hard to compute; NP-hard to approximate within any multiplicative factor
results.quote: Given a marriage instance \(G=(A\cup B,E)\) with a function \(\mathsf{cost}:E\rightarrow\{0,1\}\), it is NP-hard to compute a min-cost quasi-popular matching in G. Moreover, it is NP-hard to approximate its cost within any multiplicative factor.

results.previous_best: NP-hard to approximate min-cost popular matching to any factor
results.quote: Given a marriage instance \(G=(A\cup B,E)\) with a function \(\mathsf{cost}:E\rightarrow\mathbb{R}\), there is a polynomial time algorithm to compute a quasi-popular matching M such that \(\mathsf{cost}(M)\le\mathsf{opt}\), where opt is the cost of a min-cost popular matching in G.

results.problem: popular matching polytope and quasi-popular matching polytope extension complexity
results.quote: The extension complexity of the polytope P (also, of the polytope Q) is \(2^{\Omega(\frac{m}{logm})}\).

results.bound: formulation of size \(O(|M_G|)\) in \(\mathbb{R}^m\); \(\Omega(c^m)\) facets for some constant \(c>1\)
results.previous_best: no complete linear description of D_G in the original space was known so far
results.quote: The dominant matching polytope D_G admits a formulation of size O(|M_G|) in R^m. Moreover, there exists a constant c>1 such that D_G has \Omega(c^m) facets.

results.problem: min-cost quasi-popular matching via popular fractional matching
results.previous_best: cost(M) \le opt where opt is min-cost popular matching (Theorem 2)
results.quote: Given a marriage instance \(G=(A\cup B,E)\) with a function \(\mathsf{cost}:E\rightarrow\mathbb{R}\), there is a polynomial time algorithm to compute a quasi-popular matching N such that \(\mathsf{cost}(N)\le\mathsf{cost}(\mathbf{q})\), where **q** is a min-cost popular fractional matching in G.

results.bound: polynomial-size extended formulation R_G defined by constraints (19)-(24)
results.quote: The polytope R_G defined by constraints (19)-(24) is an extended formulation of the dominant matching polytope of G.
